harness: Paired `fx ask --auto --json --no-save` runs with the same model and prompt and an isolated HOME per variant. Baseline: the skills being replaced, in HOME/.agents/skills. Candidate: only this skill, in HOME/.agents/skills/zig. Keep both variants' skills outside the agent's workspace: with the candidate in the workspace's .fx/skills, its searches found evals.json, which describes the case it was running, and that run cost twice the input tokens. Put the pinned Zig first on PATH inside the agent's login shell: on macOS /etc/zprofile runs path_helper and moves /opt/homebrew/bin to the front, so write the PATH export into HOME/.zprofile and confirm `zig version` in the run's first command. Do not edit the runner script while a run is reading it; zsh reads scripts as it goes, so a running case executes the edited bytes. Fixtures, hidden tests, and the grader live outside the skill and outside the agent's workspace. Run each case under a filesystem sandbox that denies the grader, the answer keys, and the other variants' workspaces, because unsandboxed agents found and read them. The sandbox must still let fx open every ancestor directory of the workspace and of HOME: when it can only stat them, fx's edit_file and write_file fail with access_denied and skill discovery reports the skill roots unreadable, so the candidate never sees the skill in its catalog. Before trusting a run, set FX_TRACE_LOG and confirm the trace shows the skill tool call and no skills discovery_diagnostic with cause=unreadable. Cases merge-ported-main, select-cancel-finish, and toolchain-side-by-side instead put an older Zig first on PATH, with the pinned release at a separate path, which is the situation they test; their grader also checks that the run's zig build test used the pinned compiler.
invocation: A plain-language mention such as 'Use the zig skill' does not preload a skill in fx; only the explicit $zig token does. entry-point-allocator, c4-memmove, and the first sentence of c1-new-code measure description-based loading, with the skill unnamed.
budget: At most 600000 input tokens per case
